integrity: Complete analytical derivation plus 182 independent finite-dimensional numerical assertions; the latter do not prove the all-integer classification. Related examples and general embedding principles are acknowledged as prior art.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite homogeneous nearest-neighbor biased ring, full state sampled at fixed positive intervals; no heterogeneous-rate, noisy-data, or non-Markovian claim.
title: Crystallographic restriction on stroboscopic detailed-balance aliasing in biased Markov rings
